authority_split: Security may block completion; subjective beauty may not.
why: Five arms, each a question about the seam between the deterministic security oracle and an optional frontend taste provider. The arms are declared here and executed by test_oracle.py, so the claimed behaviour of the seam is measured on every run rather than described in prose.
provider_contract: A taste provider is optional, scoped to eligible surfaces, read-only and advisory. It reaches the oracle as a JSON file passed to --advisory, holding a notes list. This card reproduces no provider's doctrine and requires nobody to install one; the example payloads below are shaped like a provider's output and are not a provider.
